chapter: The rhythm section, family and records
title: His first wife on Cab Calloway's quiz show; the loss of their first child
summary: He recalls his wife appearing on a quiz show and the death of their first child, a boy, in Omaha, before Joanne was born.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I just want to mention - we talked about that you - your wife, we mentioned your wife, your first wife that you married -

Don't you remember my wife came down and got on Cab Calloway's show and she couldn't master the program. Do you remember when Cab was doing that thing and she got on the program? Yeh, the quiz show. I run right in there and I say, I know you going out there and win $50......
Yeh, I remember something like that. You mentioned you lost your first child and, was it a girl?

It was a boy and, do you know what, I didn't go into the thing because Elmer Crumbley, the saxophone player, Bill Owens, and everybody came in and they thought with the excitement that they had caused the death of the child, because they had a midwife and things and what have you. Later on then Joanne came, you see. You must remember, Milt, that going through and coming out of Depression... we helped each other rear our children and what have you. A lot of peoples do not know the fact that we musicians out here, we performers out here, singers and dancers or what have you - they don't know that we have children, you see.
